exact_claim: In the tied CA5-GNC-R quadratic action (Z = (ell S_k/4) phi, U = phi - Z, conserved dust stress T = rho (1,v,v^2), longitudinal modes k || v with omega = k v, box-averaged real amplitudes, rest-isotropy pins), the order-v^2 consistency residual of the E_A momentum equation at the pinned rest-isotropic configuration, evaluated at the solved series, is R = -8 rho / D with D = S_k alpha ell - 2 S_k c_N ell - 2 S_k ell - 4 alpha + 8 c_N + 24; R is k-independent and c2-free after reduction. At the branch-faithful point (alpha = 0, c_N = 1, S_k = ell = 1, c2 = 1) D = 28 and R = -2 rho/7 != 0 for rho > 0 (raw print 'branch-eval (alpha=0): -2*rho/7'); at the rational substitution-back sample R = -1280/8133 != 0. Hence the pinned rest-isotropic configuration cannot carry the conserved moving-source stress at order v^2, and the same-action PPN alpha2 extraction is OBSTRUCTED at O(v^2) in this sector: the two printed extraction windows give inconsistent tentative values (g'03 window -2/(7 M_P^2); g'00 window (49 M_P^2 - 2 rho)/(49 M_P^2 rho) at branch), the GR limit of the extraction is singular (alpha2(alpha=0,c2=0,ell=0) = nan), and the density-only negative control also fires (nonzero), so the obstruction is a property of the static sector, not of the (Psi+A) rho v^2 shift-matter coupling. Domain: all real parameters with M_P^2 != 0, D != 0, rho > 0; branch family c_N = 1 - alpha/2, c2 = 1, S_k ell = 1 has no crossing (residual != 0 for all finite D != 0; alpha = 14/3 is a pole).
